claims.claim_text: Ricursive Intelligence released Ripple-65B Preview, an open-weight model that it says sets a U.S. open-weight state of the art on agentic coding.
claims.excerpt: Today, we release Ripple-65B Preview, a general-purpose variant of the proprietary model that powers our AI chip design platform.

claims.claim_text: Ricursive says Ripple-65B Preview scores 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1, which it describes as the U.S. open-weight state of the art.
claims.excerpt: achieving U.S. open-weight state-of-the-art (80.52) on TerminalBench 2.1

claims.claim_text: Ricursive reports that Ripple-65B Preview outscores Reflection Beam 501B (80.1), Meta Muse Spark Open 816B (76.4), Thinking Machines Inkling 975B (63.8) and NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B (56.4) on TerminalBench 2.1.
claims.excerpt: surpassing significantly larger US open-weight models such as Reflection Beam 501B (80.1), Meta Muse Spark Open 816B (76.4), Thinking Machines Inkling 975B (63.8), and NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B (56.4).

claims.claim_text: The model was pretrained on 12 trillion tokens and supports up to a 1M-token context length.
claims.excerpt: The model is pretrained on 12 trillion tokens with support for up to 1M context length.

claims.claim_text: Ricursive says it spent $32M on full R&D to develop Ripple-65B Preview, about one-tenth the cost of the previous open-weight SOTA on agentic coding, by its own estimate.
claims.excerpt: we developed and trained Ripple-65B Preview for only $32M, which is one-tenth the cost of the previous open-weight SOTA on agentic coding, as estimated to the best of our knowledge.

claims.claim_text: Ricursive says Ripple-65B Preview reached its TerminalBench 2.1 score of 80.5 using only 1.4M rollouts, roughly 70x fewer than Reflection Beam.
claims.excerpt: We reached a TerminalBench 2.1 score of 80.5 with only 1.4M rollouts, roughly 70x fewer rollouts than Reflection Beam, the prior SOTA.

claims.claim_text: Ripple-65B Preview is a dense Transformer with 80 layers and a d_model of 5120, rather than a Mixture-of-Experts design.
claims.excerpt: Ripple-65B Preview uses a thin-and-deep model aspect ratio, with a narrow d_model (5120) and 80 total layers.

claims.claim_text: Ripple-65B Preview is available on Hugging Face, Together AI, GMI Cloud, OpenRouter, and Fireworks.
claims.excerpt: Ripple-65B Preview is available on Hugging Face, Together AI, GMI Cloud, OpenRouter, and Fireworks.

claims.claim_text: Ricursive says the model's compute efficiency on code is up to 16x better than the Olmo 3 ladder at 4B scale, as measured by dolma_stack CE.
claims.excerpt: Together, the compounded changes improved compute efficiency on code as measured by dolma_stack CE by up to 16x at 4B model scale.

claims.claim_text: Ricursive says the model's small parameter count lets it run efficiently on local devices such as NVIDIA DGX Spark.
claims.excerpt: The model's small parameter envelope also enables it to run efficiently on local devices such as NVIDIA DGX Spark
